findings.problem: A validated bodyHeadBank cannot coexist with bodySpeech, bodyEyes, bodyExpressions, or bodySecondary. This makes combined native selections impossible, including expressions, whose own validation requires registered eyes and resting speech. applyTopicCast therefore still rejects rather than preserving exact Lila/Karo native controls when they are supplied together with the native head bank.
findings.sourceEvidence: The bodyHeadBank guard rejects when a.bodySpeech || a.bodyEyes || a.bodyExpressions || a.bodySecondary. The same schema requires bodyExpressions to have registered eyes and registered-rest-mouth-v1, while the acting brief describes native head candidates as providing bounded mouth/activity and eye/blink controls when capabilities support them.
findings.repair: Permit these controls when the selected bank's registered capabilities and actor/view identity validate them; retain the existing actor, version, body-view, and completeness guards. Do not infer any missing capability.

dispositions.reason: bodySpeech/bodyEyes/bodyExpressions/bodySecondary are registered to the fixed whole-body head drawing. Bank3/4 uses independent PNG/face-specific regions; a speech/eye capability on that bank cannot validate the principal fixed-view ROIs or its hair. Mixing them would paint the wrong source face. The helper preserves only valid selections; source-native bank speech/eyes are inherent capabilities, not those fixed-view flags. Existing mutually exclusive schema/body-head guards remain unchanged.
